title: Content audit of Quillbridge
verdict: Data platforms has a working journey from first read to the checklist download; forecasting has no path to a hand-raise and its demand never reaches a lead.
works: The data-platform service page links to the case study and the contact form.
doesnt: Forecasting has 0 Interest pages and no Action page linked from its pages.
channel_read: Fix forecasting content before buying traffic for it.

offering_notes.data-platform: Covered at every stage except a thin Attention layer.
offering_notes.forecasting: One service page and one blog post; nothing explains approaches or asks for contact.

valueprop_read: The homepage states what and for whom; it never says why Quillbridge.
findability_read: Most impressions come from an off-ICP spreadsheet tutorial.
traffic_read: Paid search carries the data-platform service page.

priorities.action: Write three approach guides for forecasting buyers
Add a contact step to the forecasting service page
priorities.evidence: No body link to an Action page

limits: Fixture data, not a real site.
